ids.description: Ids of the entries confirmed this round. Each must be a live (non-stale, non-superseded) CONFIRMED entry in this repository's KB whose recorded file basis still matches the cited files at the repo's HEAD commit (the same rule kb_export applies; uncommitted edits are ignored); any other id is skipped and reported in skipped (reason not_confirmed_or_unknown, no_source_files for a CONFIRMED entry citing no source file, or basis_mismatch). An id the current bible file carries a withdrawn tombstone for is skipped with reason withdrawn_tombstone and its tombstone kept, unless restore_ids undoes that tombstone in the same call. An id the file carries a demoted tombstone for is merged only when its local trust time is strictly after the tombstone at (a real re-promotion, which clears the tombstone); otherwise it is skipped with reason demoted_tombstone and the tombstone kept. An id found in both entries and demotions loses its entry on every call (removed, reason tombstoned). Independently of the ids, every bible entry this KB holds as superseded or invalidated is removed and reported in removed; an empty list with no such entry makes no commit.

demoted_ids.description: Ids demoted this round (kb_demote). Each must name a local entry that HAS a demoted_at and is now below CONFIRMED; any other id is skipped and reported in skipped with reason not_demoted_or_unknown. An id the current bible file carries a withdrawn tombstone for is skipped with reason withdrawn_tombstone and that tombstone is kept unchanged: a demoted tombstone never replaces a withdrawn one (only restore_ids lifts a withdrawal). An admitted id is REMOVED from entries and recorded as an explicit tombstone {id, at, reason: "demoted"} in the bible demotions array, so other clones can apply the demotion instead of inferring it from an absence. Independently, every call does the same for each bible entry this KB holds as demoted, unless that bible entry was promoted after the local demotion (another clone re-promoted it). A demoted tombstone is written only for an id the bible at baseCommit carries (as an entry or a tombstone): an entry this branch added (absent from the base) is removed from entries with no tombstone, and any other demoted_ids id is skipped with reason not_in_base_bible. When baseCommit does not resolve or its bible is unreadable, no new demoted tombstone is written, such demoted_ids ids are skipped with not_in_base_bible, and the result carries base_bible_error with the reason. Re-admitting the same id through ids (a re-promotion) clears its tombstone.

id.description: Id of the bible entry being withdrawn.

note.description: Why the entry no longer holds -- at least 20 characters after whitespace is collapsed. Stored collapsed in the tombstone.

evidence_files.description: At least one repo-relative file the judgement was checked against; an absolute path or a ".." segment is refused.

withdrawals.description: Bible entries withdrawn this round: [{id, note, evidence_files}]. An id is admitted when the bible already holds an entry for it, or this KB holds it CONFIRMED, not superseded and not a user-directive; any other id is skipped with reason not_withdrawable. An admitted id is removed from entries and recorded as a tombstone {id, at: now, reason: "withdrawn", note, evidence_files}; the local entry is NOT changed (the withdrawal takes effect for clones only once the branch merges). An id also merged through ids, or admitted through demoted_ids, in the same call is skipped (not_withdrawable). Under an http KB provider every well-formed withdrawal is admitted and only the tombstone is written.

restore_ids.description: Ids whose tombstone this branch added and should be undone. A tombstone is removed only when the bible at baseCommit carries none for that id; the base bible's entry for the id, when it has one, is re-added byte-identical. Any other id is a no-op. Restored ids are reported in restored.

baseBranch.description: The sprint's target base branch (the branch the work merges into). Written to provenance.branch.

baseCommit.description: The base commit the entries were verified against. Written to provenance.commit.

repo_path.description: REMOVED -- do not pass. A call carrying it fails with E-SCOPE-KEY-REMOVED; the KB is always the calling session's own.

repo.description: REMOVED -- do not pass. A call carrying it fails with E-SCOPE-KEY-REMOVED; the KB is always the calling session's own.

repo_remote_url.description: REMOVED -- do not pass. A call carrying it fails with E-SCOPE-KEY-REMOVED; the KB is always the calling session's own.
